evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce SocialArena, a benchmark for systematically defining and evaluating the social intelligence of large language models (LLMs).

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: To operationalize this definition, we design a role-playing dialogue paradigm with explicit character thinking for evaluation, enabling simultaneous assessment of these capabilities in a manner that mirrors realistic human interactions. (2) To ensure diversity across social scenarios and thereby prevent evaluation conclusions from being confined to specific scenarios, we introduce the U-TRIMF framework, which guides us in synthesizing social contexts with broad coverage. (3) To obtain reliable evaluation, we invest $132.4K to recruit and train human annotators and adopt a human-annotated arena-style protocol, where annotators compare model responses and provide preference labels along with natural-language critiques.
